name: community-passives
summary: Hero passives and Wylde's reload that a death, stun, channel or cast could switch off for a whole match start again (Wylde's ammo, Fiorne's Bunny Stacks, Rowan, Somnia, Zoey)

assets.why: Wylde, Hunter's Brand: the passive can start while the hero is dead, stunned or channeling, like every other hero's passive (Ability.Passive only). A refused start left it off for the rest of the match (Wylde 0 ammo, Fiorne 0 Bunny Stacks).

Wylde's reload, which runs all match and fills his gun (also the fill at each round start): it can start while he is casting, channeling or dead. A refused start left him with 0 ammo for the rest of the match. Reloading itself stays gated inside the ability (Can Reload).

Fiorne, Duelist's Momentum (it also grants her Bunny Stacks): the passive can start while the hero is dead, stunned or channeling, like every other hero's passive (Ability.Passive only). A refused start left it off for the rest of the match (Wylde 0 ammo, Fiorne 0 Bunny Stacks).
